description: This file defines structures, enums, and function prototypes for filtering objects during a list-object traversal in a version control system, including filter result codes, situations, and filter management functions.

methods.name: list_objects_filter__init
methods.description: Constructor for creating a filter object with optional omitted set and filter options.

methods.name: list_objects_filter__filter_object
methods.description: Determines how to handle a specific object during traversal based on the filter.

methods.name: list_objects_filter__free
methods.description: Frees and finalizes the filter object and associated omitted set.
